title: The Balcony Cathedral
content: So I saw it again, I’m gonna try and piece together the experience, I’m groggy. It’s something like an extremely dated southern church sanctuary, almost comprised entirely of 4 colors and shapes: A sea foam green thick carpeting on all floors and stairs, thick to comfortably sit and not be considered “shag carpeting”. Eggshell white walls, with ornate wainscoting etc., as well as the side/legs of pews. Dark Oak Wood pew benches. The railing around the center (like a balcony) with stair rails, and maybe some organ piping all brass. Beautiful intricate etchings on each and immaculate. It’s this place I’ve seen a few times, and has a use- because when it showed up in my dream I already remember being there, to the extent I was explaining the room’s function or trick to another dreamer. It doesn’t feel like you are on a second floor, but are surprised to come through a door and be now on a balcony of a cathedral. There are five or six treads/platforms/levels and they are turned 45° or 30° something designed so people can see downstairs “down the hole” other than the geometric turning it’s similar to what I’ve seen in churches. Maybe the design is like this for audio purpose only? What’s weird about this balcony otherwise is that it’s four-sided, and a square shaped opening that signals “the show is up here” edges clean besides two platforms inconspicuously sized. The platforms are odd, purpose-built, only room for one person to stand or sit crisscross legged, and have no visible railing… well they do but it’s functionality is different- instead of the rounded brass being stationary and all across, it’s shaped like a hook that adjusts for height of whatever is on the jutted out platforms assumedly, so they could have no railing between them, and whoever sees them from the lower level? The. Reverb. Is. Amazing. Different places in the room have delays or differentiation in echo timing and diffusion- and the little platforms near the hole sound angelic when I hum a couple notes- but someone always distracts me before I can play around or sing, even though I try to get them to leave me. I hope to see it again, I’ll be faster at using it next time.
